name: utf8proc_free
text:
#define CHECK_NORM(NRM, norm, src) {                                 \
    unsigned char *src_norm = (unsigned char*) utf8proc_ ## NRM((utf8proc_uint8_t*) src);      \
    check(!strcmp((char *) norm, (char *) src_norm),                                  \
          "normalization failed for %s -> %s", src, norm);          \
    utf8proc_free(src_norm);                                                 \
}
